prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical Japanese anime-style diagnostic poster titled 隠した感情, presenting “hidden emotion print layers” for one girl character, with a central neutral portrait and two contrasting emotional versions printed behind her in blue and red.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster, aged cream paper background with rough torn-paper collage edges, ink stains, halftone dots, faint scratches, stamped textures, and layered risograph/screenprint effects. Use a limited palette of navy blue, deep red, black line art, and warm off-white.

Layout: Large Japanese headline across the top left, with a small English subtitle beneath it reading “EMOTION PRINT LAYERS” and a handwritten cursive word “Layers” near the title. Under the subtitle, add a small Japanese tagline: “みんなに見せる顔と、本当のわたしは、ちょっと違うんだ。” The center foreground contains the main character in clean black-and-white line art, overlapping both colored background layers. Behind her are exactly 2 large monochrome emotion portraits: one blue portrait on the left and one red portrait on the right. Add exactly 2 torn label cards: a blue card at lower left and a red card at mid-lower right. Add exactly 3 small white rabbit motifs: one tiny rabbit icon near the red top corner, one plush-like rabbit at the bottom left, and one plush-like rabbit at the bottom right.

Subject details: The character is a delicate anime girl with very long pale blonde hair, soft gray eyes, blush, floral hair ornaments, small rabbit hair clip, earrings, and a lacy white camisole dress. The central portrait shows her shyly winking with one eye open, shoulders turned slightly, gentle blush, loose flowing hair and floral accessories. The blue left background portrait shows the same girl looking inward and melancholic, resting her hand near her mouth, with a quiet closed-off pose. The red right background portrait shows the same girl energetic and extroverted, smiling with open mouth and pointing directly toward the viewer.

Text content: Blue torn card title: “✿ 内向きの声”. Blue card body: “本当は、人の目がこわい。嫌われたくないから、先に心を引っ込めちゃう。” Red torn card title: “✿ 外向きの声”. Red card body: “もっと私を見てほしい！可愛いって、言わせてみせる。主役は、わたし。” Keep all Japanese text crisp and legible, printed in white on colored cards where appropriate.

Visual style: Manga illustration with fine expressive linework, soft blush shading, vintage poster typography, torn washi paper collage, overprinted red and blue ink layers, distressed halftone texture, slightly imperfect registration, decorative flower symbols, handmade zine aesthetic.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 central character, exactly 2 colored emotion portraits, exactly 2 text cards, and exactly 3 rabbit motifs. Do not add extra characters, extra cards, logos, watermarks, or modern UI elements. Keep the composition dense but balanced, with the central black-and-white portrait clearly dominant.

promptZh:
目标：创作一张竖版日本动漫风格的诊断海报，标题为 隠した感情，展示一位少女角色的“隐藏情感打印层”，中心为中性肖像，身后以蓝色和红色印制两个对比鲜明的情感版本。

画布：竖版 4:5 海报，做旧的米色纸张背景，带有粗糙的撕纸拼贴边缘、墨渍、半调网点、细微划痕、印章纹理以及分层的孔版印刷/丝网印刷效果。使用海军蓝、深红、黑色线条和暖米色的有限调色板。

布局：左上方为醒目的日语大标题，下方配有小型英语副标题“EMOTION PRINT LAYERS”，标题附近有手写草书单词“Layers”。副标题下方添加一行日语标语：“みんなに見せる顔と、本当のわたしは、ちょっと違うんだ。” 中心前景是干净的黑白线条画风格主角，与背景的两个彩色层重叠。她身后有 2 幅大型单色情感肖像：左侧为蓝色肖像，右侧为红色肖像。添加 2 张撕裂的标签卡：左下角一张蓝色卡片，右中下部一张红色卡片。添加 3 个白色小兔子图案：红色顶角附近一个小兔子图标，左下角一只毛绒质感兔子，右下角一只毛绒质感兔子。

角色细节：角色为 一位精致的动漫少女，留着极长的浅金色长发，拥有柔和的灰色眼睛、腮红、花朵发饰、小兔子发夹、耳环和蕾丝白色吊带裙。中心肖像展示她羞涩地眨着一只眼，肩膀微侧，带着温柔的腮红，头发飘逸，配有花朵装饰。左侧蓝色背景肖像展示了同一个女孩内心忧郁的一面，手放在嘴边，姿态安静且封闭。右侧红色背景肖像展示了同一个女孩充满活力和外向的一面，张嘴微笑并直指观众。

文本内容：蓝色撕裂卡片标题：“✿ 内向きの声”。蓝色卡片正文：“本当は、人の目がこわい。嫌われたくないから、先に心を引っ込めちゃう。” 红色撕裂卡片标题：“✿ 外向きの声”。红色卡片正文：“もっと私を見てほしい！可愛いって、言わせてみせる。主役は、わたし。” 确保所有日语文本清晰易读，在彩色卡片上以白色印制。

视觉风格：漫画插画，线条细腻且富有表现力，柔和的腮红阴影，复古海报排版，和纸撕纸拼贴，红色与蓝色墨水叠印，做旧半调纹理，轻微的套印不准，装饰性花朵符号，手工杂志美学。

约束条件：使用 1 个中心角色，2 幅彩色情感肖像，2 张文本卡片，以及 3 个兔子图案。不要添加额外的角色、卡片、Logo、水印或现代 UI 元素。保持构图紧凑但平衡，中心黑白肖像需占据主导地位。
